purpose: PSD-to-UIIR semantic refinement after optional vision proposal fusion.
rules: Do not invent or edit pixel coordinates.
Do not output Screen for any candidate; Screen is a synthetic root created by the program.
Do not downgrade a concrete local type to Unknown.
Do not reclassify local Text candidates as Image, Container, or decorative controls.
Do not switch high-confidence concrete candidates across type families.
Only change Container into Button/Input/Toggle/Slider when component_group_id evidence is present.
Prefer PSD text layer content over OCR or visual guesses.
Use parent_candidate_id only when it references a supplied candidate id or layer ref.
Use component_group_id only to wrap existing sibling candidates into runtime UI components.
Return JSON that matches the strict structured output schema.
